scripts.dev:kill: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ports = @(3000,3001); $pids = @(); foreach ($p in $ports) { $pids += (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique) }; $pids = $pids | Sort-Object -Unique; foreach ($pid in $pids) { Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if (Test-Path '.next/dev/lock') { Remove-Item '.next/dev/lock' -Force }"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run dev:kill && npm run dev
